notes: Deploy customer first and verify every customer instance is on the CHG-101 read-model version before deploying ledger. The customer rollout must accept both queued legacy payment.posted events with decimal amount and new events with amountMinor. Ledger instances can then be switched one at a time; old ledger instances publish amount while new instances publish amountMinor, and the new customer handles both. A ledger rollback is safe because it resumes legacy events, which the new customer still accepts. Existing ledger storage and synchronous post/balance/postings contracts are unchanged.
